# Fixture

Derived brand tokens - primary oklch(47.83% 0.0975 164.85), scheme mono, surface light, contrast comfort.

## Logos

- [Fixture mark, mono](logos/fixture/logo/mono.svg): light surfaces. Asset id `fixture/logo/mono`.
- [Fixture mark](logos/fixture/logo/primary.svg): light surfaces. Asset id `fixture/logo/primary`.
- [Fixture mark, reverse](logos/fixture/logo/reverse.svg): dark surfaces. Asset id `fixture/logo/reverse`.

Owner-published, not an open licence: Fixture mark, Fixture mark, reverse.
